reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: Rights Issue of Ordinary Voting Shares
reqBaseAnnouncement.votingShrsPropToBeIssued: 8 new Ordinary Voting Shares for every 17 Ordinary Voting Shares held
reqBaseAnnouncement.perposeOfTheIssue: The funds raised from the Rights Issue will be used to partially settle the Company's existing bank borrowings and overdue inter-company trade and other payables (all being interest bearing dues), thereby substantially strengthening the Company's overall financial position and capital structure.
